description: For skcapstone's fleet lock: Renovate's pip-compile manager reruns the uv command in the lock's header, so every bump arrives as a regenerated lock that faces the fleet-lock gate.

packageRules.description: The fleet lock's inputs are exact SK pins and unpinned tools, not capped library ranges: bump the pins weekly (patch merges itself after the whole gate is green), never treat them as cap-lift PRs.
